AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1-8)
1.
APPROVAL OF WARRANTS
Recommendation: Review and Approve Warrant Register of April 23, 2024.
WARRANTS
2.
RECEIVE AND FILE THE FINANCIAL STATEMENT FOR THE MONTH ENDING APRIL 30, 2024
Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the financial statement for the month ending April 30, 2024.
Staff Report
3.
MAY 21, 2024 PLANNING COMMISSION ACTIONS
Recommendation: Receive and file.
Staff Report
4.
SPECIAL EVENT APPLICATION AND REQUEST TO POST SIGNS/FLAGS FOR THE ANNUAL PALOS VERDES INDEPENDENCE DAY CELEBRATION ON THURSDAY, JULY 4TH, 2024, AT THE MALAGA COVE SCHOOL GROUNDS FROM 7:30 A.M. TO 3:00 P.M.
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Special Event Application and request to post signs/flags for the annual Palos Verdes Independence Day Celebration at the Malaga Cove School grounds on Thursday, July 4, 2024, from 7:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Staff Report
5.
CITY COUNCIL APPROVAL OF FY 2024/25 BEACH CLUB OPERATING AND CAPITAL RESERVE BUDGET AND APPROVAL OF UPDATED BYLAWS
Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve:
1.
Proposed FY 2024/2025 Operating and Capital Reserve Budget for the Palos Verdes Beach and Athletic Club (Beach Club); and
2.
Revised Club Bylaws.
Staff Report
6.
ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R24-22 APPROVING THE PURCHASE OF A REPLACEMENT POLICE PATROL VEHICLE (INCLUDING VEHICLE OUTFITTING) IN AN AMOUNT NOT-TO-EXCEED $79,279.00
Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council adopt Resolution R24-22: (1) approving the purchase of a replacement police patrol vehicle in an amount not-to-exceed $79,279.00.
Staff Report
7.
APPROVAL OF MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING ("MOU") BETWEEN THE CITY AND PALOS VERDES ESTATES PUBLIC SERVICE EMPLOYEES' ("PSE") ASSOCIATION.
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt the proposed Resolution R24-23 and approve the Memorandum of Understanding ("MOU") between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and the Palos Verdes Estates Public Service Employees ("PSE") Association.
Staff Report
UPDATED STAFF REPORT
8.
ADOPTION OF PROPOSED RESOLUTION R24-24 CORRECTING RESOLUTION R22-23 AND FOR RESOLUTION R23-29, THE GANN APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 22-23 AND FISCAL YEAR 2023-24
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt proposed resolution R24-24 revising the Appropriations Limit for the City of Palos Verdes Estates for Fiscal Year’s for 2022-23 and 2023-24.
Staff Report
PUBLIC HEARING
10.
SIXTH CYCLE 2021-2029 HOUSING ELEMENT
1.
City Council adopt Resolution No. R24-21 approving GPA-001-024, General Plan Amendment for the sixth cycle 2021-2029 Housing Element amending the Housing Element of the City of Palos Verdes Estates General Plan.
2.
Find that General Plan Amendment GPA-001-24 is exempt from California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) requirements per Section 5061(b)(3)
Staff Report
Staff Report(Revised)
Attachment A-CC Resolution No. R24-21(Revised)
OLD BUSINESS
9.
CITY COUNCIL DISCUSSION ON NONSTANDARD ENCROACHMENT REQUESTS AND REQUIREMENTS AND PROVIDING FEEDBACK
Recommendation: That the City Council discuss nonstandard encroachment requests and requirements and provide feedback.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
11.
APPROVAL OF PALOS VERDES GOLF CLUB CENTENNIAL PROJECT - CLUBHOUSE RENOVATIONS/ADDITIONS
Recommendation: That the City Council approve the request of Palos Verdes Golf Club to complete significant improvements to the Palos Verdes Golf Club clubhouse facilities, including a new two-story building in replacement of the current Pro Shop and bag storage & renovations/improvements to the existing main clubhouse to include enhanced and enlarged fitness areas.
